title: Product A: Contraindications and Precautions
shortdesc: Information on safety and contraindications for Product A.

sections.content:
Product A is contraindicated in patients with the following conditions:
- Known severe hypersensitivity to Product A or any of its excipients.
- Severe baseline myelosuppression (absolute neutrophil count < 500/mm³ or platelet count < 50,000/mm³).
- Severe hepatic impairment (total bilirubin > 3x upper limit of normal).

Before administering Product A, consider the following safety precautions:
- Monitor complete blood counts (CBC) prior to initiating each cycle and routinely during treatment.
- Assess for signs of febrile neutropenia or active systemic infection before each dose.
- Monitor hepatic function tests and serum electrolyte levels during administration to assess for potential tumor lysis syndrome (TLS).
